# First-Day High-Intent Visitors

## Description

Brand-new visitors already clicking around heavily on their first day, surfaced to sales as a hot-lead draft with a ready-to-send push nudge back to the site.

## Steps

### Step 1: Build the first-day high-intent list

Build a segment of users named "First-Day High-Intent Visitors". A user is in the segment only when all of these are true: triggered "Session start" at least once in the last 1 day; did not trigger "Session start" more than 1 day ago; triggered the click event (a tracked click on a page element) at least 5 times in the last 1 day.

### Step 2: Draft a sales alert

Generate a Slack message to the sales team channel. State how many users are in "First-Day High-Intent Visitors" right now, using the member count in the result of "Build the first-day high-intent list". If that result carries no count, write no number and no placeholder in square brackets; say instead that the list is saved as the segment "First-Day High-Intent Visitors" and can be opened in Segments. Say these are brand-new visitors already showing strong interest today. This drafts the Slack message only; a person on the team still posts it.

### Step 3: Draft a nudge push

Generate a push notification for the users in "First-Day High-Intent Visitors" inviting them back to pick up where they left off. Title under 40 characters, one short body line, friendly and curious tone. Use the result of "Build the first-day high-intent list". Write no link, URL, template tag or placeholder in the title or body; the push opens the site or app. This drafts the push only; a person still sends it.
